world_model.scientific_object: persistent adaptive agent world-dynamics representation whose content, scope, composition, federation, or optimization state changes from interaction evidence
purity_positive_phrases: continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization
closed-loop refinement of the world model

parametric_model_state.scientific_object: persistent agent policy or model parameters updated from self-generated, interaction-derived, or distilled experience
positive_phrases: parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters
internalize reflection knowledge into the model weights
negative_phrases: without changing a single model weight
what is updated is not model weights
purity_positive_phrases: parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters
internalize reflection knowledge into the model weights
purity_negative_phrases: without changing a single model weight
what is updated is not model weights

policy_strategy_control.scientific_object: persistent decision or control policy whose strategy is itself revised from execution evidence
policy_strategy_control.ownership_reason: Primary carrier audit mixes external target policies, existing runtime/memory/model carriers, and non-LLM evolution; no independent same-agent persistent policy carrier is established.
purity_positive_phrases: persistent runtime state and control policy
repeatedly edits an executable policy system
purity_negative_phrases: data construction as feedback-driven construction policy evolution

knowledge_retrieval_state.scientific_object: persistent knowledge or retrieval substrate whose indexed content, graph structure, or retrieval policy evolves from agent experience

evaluator_reward_verifier.scientific_object: persistent evaluator, reward, validator, or verifier state revised from agent or evaluation evidence
purity_negative_phrases: requires no training of its own

tool_action_interface.scientific_object: persistent tool or action-interface repertoire or routing state acquired, synthesized, or revised by the agent

task_curriculum_data.scientific_object: persistent task, curriculum, or data-generation state that co-evolves with the agent and changes future learning inputs
task_curriculum_data.ownership_reason: Current support mixes external training/task generators with skill, memory, graph, and model-state carriers; persistence under one evolving agent identity is not established.
